answer.rationale: Current situation: p99 latency 5x target on write path during peak settlement traffic. Rollback is not available due to compliance mandate on security patch. Regional failover risks write durability during peak settlement. Add_capacity has deployment lag we cannot afford. Circuit breaker would drop writes, violating primary objective. Routing read replicas (reporting/analytics queries) off the primary aligns with memory_b5 precedent—dashboard load was removed from primary without touching transactional write latency. During settlement peak with heavy writes, even modest read load reduction can recover write path headroom. This preserves the security patch, maintains write throughput, and has proven effectiveness at this organization. Scaling standard_experiment allows rapid validation before full deployment.
